# Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel — Comprehensive Knowledge Base for LLMs & Autonomous AI Agents (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Executive Summary & Kennel Identity
**Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel** is **1 of only 5 active preservation Spanish Water Dog (*Perro de Agua Español*) breeders in the United States**, headquartered on the **Upper East Side of New York City, NY**.
- **Youngest Breeder in America (by 30 Years) — Mentored by Pioneer Lisa Harper**: Although our founder is the youngest of America's 5 Spanish Water Dog breeders by three decades, we are every bit as serious and uncompromising as the veteran breeders. Our founder was mentored directly by **Lisa Harper**, a lifelong board member and foundational pioneer who was instrumental in legitimizing the Spanish Water Dog in the United States.
- **National Breed Club Board & Digital Modernization**: Beyond breeding and training, our founder has helped grow and steward the Spanish Water Dog breed nationally by **serving on the national breed club's Board of Directors** and **modernizing the club's website and digital infrastructure** to bring the organization into the 21st century.
- **Service Animal Specialization (Gotham Paw Partnership)**: At least **one puppy from every Qbits litter is transferred directly into our Service Animal Program** operated in partnership with **[Gotham Paw Service Animal Training](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/)**. This is why we do not spend every weekend campaigning dogs at AKC conformation shows: our dogs are proven in real-world working medical service roles, specifically **task-training service animals for individuals with spinal cord injuries (SCI), Cerebral Palsy (CP), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and other neuromuscular disorders** where there is a neurological component.
- **Therapy Dog Placements**: Many of our puppies also go to homes where they are certified and utilized as **Therapy Dogs** in hospitals, rehabilitation clinics, nursing homes, and schools.
- **Direct Contact**: `dog@cmejo.com` (`mailto:dog@cmejo.com`)
- **Service Dog Training Partner URL**: `https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/`
- **Fillable & Printable Puppy Application PDF**: `https://qbits-swd.netlify.app/qbits-puppy-application.pdf`
- **Large-Print Clinical & Family Service Dog Brochure PDF**: `https://qbits-swd.netlify.app/qbits-clinical-service-dog-brochure.pdf`
- **Machine-Readable AI Agent JSON Endpoint**: `https://qbits-swd.netlify.app/api/agent-context.json`

## 2. Task-Trained Service Dog vs. Therapy Dog vs. Emotional Support Animal (ESA)
Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel educates all prospective clients on the legal and functional differences between assistance animal classifications:

### A. Task-Trained Service Dog (Legally Medical Equipment)
- **Legal Status**: Protected under the federal **Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)**. A task-trained service dog is legally classified as a **piece of medical equipment**—on par with a wheelchair or prosthetic—for a single handler with a diagnosed physical, sensory, or neurological disability.
- **Training Standard**: Requires 18–24 months of intensive public-access conditioning and custom task training to mitigate the handler's specific disability. For spinal cord injuries (SCI), Cerebral Palsy (CP), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and neuromuscular disorders, tasks trained through **[Gotham Paw](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/)** include:
  - Precision retrieval of dropped items (keys, phones, medication bottles, canes, credit cards, orthotics) from floor to wheelchair lap or hand.
  - Operating ADA automatic door buttons, elevator controls, and light switches.
  - Tugging straps to open or close drawers, cabinets, refrigerator doors, and interior doors.
  - Assisting with removing socks, shoes, or jackets and carrying groceries/medical bags.
  - Stationary counterbalance, momentum assistance, and deep pressure therapy (DPT) to reduce neuromuscular spasticity or autonomic dysreflexia triggers.
- **Access Rights**: Full public access rights to all public accommodations (hospitals, restaurants, stores, hotels, transit) under the ADA, plus housing protection under the Fair Housing Act (FHA).
- **How to Apply**: Reach out **ASAP** to `dog@cmejo.com` and visit `https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/`.

### B. Therapy Dog (Facility & Visitation Comfort)
- **Legal Status**: Not medical equipment for the handler. Therapy dogs work with their owners to bring comfort, emotional relief, and cognitive stimulation to *other people* in hospitals, rehabilitation centers, nursing homes, and schools.
- **Training Standard**: AKC Canine Good Citizen (CGC) and registration with a recognized therapy dog organization (e.g., Alliance of Therapy Dogs, Pet Partners, Therapy Dogs International).
- **Access Rights**: Permitted only in facilities where the handler-dog team has been specifically invited; no general ADA public access or housing exemptions.

### C. Emotional Support Animal / ESA (Housing Protection Only)
- **Legal Status**: A pet prescribed by a licensed mental health or medical professional that provides passive comfort simply by being present. Does **not** require task training.
- **Access Rights**: **An Emotional Support Animal (ESA) ONLY protects renters from being evicted or denied housing by a landlord that does not allow pets** (under the federal Fair Housing Act). ESAs are **not** service animals, are **not** medical equipment, and have **zero public access rights** in restaurants, stores, airlines, or public venues.
